description: This file defines the BuzzFeedPost class, which models a post (including shares and media such as photos and videos) within a Buzz feature of the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee info, post details, sharing info, media, and methods to retrieve post attributes and related data.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPost
classes.description: Represents a social media-like post or share within the OrangeHRM Buzz system, including media, author information, and related metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the share.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the associated post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the post or share.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the post, such as video, photo, or text.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Provides statistics including number of likes, comments, and shares.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Formats and returns the creation date of the post.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Formats and returns the creation time of the post.

methods.name: getOriginalPost
methods.description: Returns details of the original post if this is a share.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns employee information associated with the post.

methods.name: isLiked
methods.description: Indicates whether the current user has liked the post.

methods.name: getVideoLink
methods.description: Returns the URL of the video if available.

methods.name: getPhotoIds
methods.description: Retrieves photo IDs associated with the post.

methods.name: hasPhotos
methods.description: Determines if the post contains photos.

methods.name: hasVideo
methods.description: Determines if the post contains a video.

methods.name: getPermission
methods.description: Returns permission flags for updating or deleting the post.
